description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 18, Quick Learner and Advanced Quick Learner ruby talents

The red mage may add one of the following abilities to his list of class features: Greater Weapon Bond (Ex): The red mage selects a weapon for which he has the Improved Weapon Bond ability. He is treated as having the Greater Weapon Focus feat for that weapon, even if he does not meet the prerequisites. Innate Spell (Su): A red mage with this ability selects one 1st level red mage spell that he knows. He may now cast that spell as a spell-like ability at will. This talent can only be taken once.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Talents)
